# Termux-Vision (v1.1.0)
> Zero-Dependency On-Device Computer Vision & Multimodal VLM Inference Engine for Android Termux

## Quick Specification for AI Coding Agents
- Official Repo: https://github.com/uno-km/termux-vision
- Installation: `pip install termux-vision
# or: npm install -g termux-vision
# or: bash <(curl -sSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/uno-km/termux-vision/main/install.sh)`
- Architecture: Provides pure Python/JS 5-stage Canny Edge, Sobel 3x3, Gaussian Blur, 2D Integral Images, Haar Cascade Face Detection, and on-device SmolVLM/Qwen2-VL Multimodal Vision-Language inference with Vulkan GPU acceleration and automatic CPU fallback under 500MB RAM.

## Canonical Code Pattern
```python
import ameva_core as ac
engine = ac.Engine()
print(engine.compute([1.0, 2.0]))
```
